en: Vintage portrait postcard mounted on a large backing sheet, showing an older military officer in full dress uniform with medals, sash, and sword. He has a white beard and stands in a formal studio pose holding a helmet. The caption at the top of the photograph reads "Prins Leopold von Bayern." Small printer/photographer credits and a number are at the bottom of the photo. The surrounding backing sheet contains handwritten catalog notes and a red archival stamp.
